original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日尔州矿工死亡事件：NSCDC矿业执法队否认参与致命行动
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚安全和民防部队（NSCDC）矿业执法队否认参与9月16日在尼日尔州明纳M.I. Wushishi住宅区发生的致命行动，称被停职的州指挥官无权部署该队人员。矿业执法队指挥官John Attah称，被停职的尼日尔州指挥官Suberu Aniviye关于其部署矿业执法队人员的说法不实且具有误导性。目前，穆罕默德·穆罕默德法官调查委员会正就事件经过及相关安全人员行为展开调查。

location.raw_text: M.I. Wushishi Housing Estate in Minna, Niger State

key_facts.fact: NSCDC矿业执法队否认参与9月16日在尼日尔州明纳的致命行动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps Mining Marshals have denied the unit’s involvement in the September 16 operation at M.I. Wushishi Housing Estate in Minna, Niger State, where deaths occurred

key_facts.fact: 矿业执法队称被停职的州指挥官无权部署其人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: insisting that the suspended state commandant lacked the authority to deploy its operatives

key_facts.fact: 矿业执法队指挥官称被停职州指挥官的相关说法不实且具有误导性
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Attah described as false and misleading claims attributed to the suspended Niger State Commandant of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps, Suberu Aniviye, that he deployed Mining Marshals personnel to the area

key_facts.fact: 穆罕默德·穆罕默德法官调查委员会正就事件展开调查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The controversy is coming amid an ongoing investigation by the Justice Mohammed Mohammed Commission of Inquiry into the circumstances surrounding the incident and the conduct of security personnel involved

uncertainties: 事件具体经过及死亡情况尚未获独立确认
矿业执法队是否参与行动存在争议，相关说法尚未证实
目前仅单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
